_doc: v2.Z/v2.Y venue location maps. One entry per fixed venue; `events` are regional /event/ slugs shown on that venue's map (Car Week events resolve through src/data/carWeekVenues.ts). lat/lon/osm are filled by scripts/venue-pins.py from OSM Nominatim; `query` is what was searched. Events with no single fixed venue (routes, downtown areas, several venues, countywide) are deliberately absent and get no map.
